next.headline: MageCart: a card-skimming group that cast a wide net over online shops
next.in_short: MageCart steals credit card numbers, often by skimming card data from ecommerce sites. WIRED reported in 2019 that it had hit 17,000 domains in a few months.

sentences.t: MageCart is the name of a group of hackers that steals credit card numbers.
According to a WIRED article published on 2019-07-11, Magecart has been behind some of the bigger hacks of recent years, from British Airways to Ticketmaster.
The group goes after ecommerce sites.
WIRED says its hackers cast the widest possible net to find vulnerable online shops.
The group's main technique is card skimming: taking card data from ecommerce sites.
WIRED describes the goal of the attacks as stealing credit card numbers.
WIRED reported that, thanks to poor security hygiene, the group hit 17,000 domains in a few months.
The article warns that the method could lead to even bigger problems. This is a forward-looking warning from the author, not a confirmed outcome.
Online shop owners should keep their sites patched and well maintained, since attackers look for the weakest ones.
